coverage_note: A few English-heavy stretches where Medi explains his app testing (03:49-06:00). Audio muffled around 36:00-37:00.

rows.medi_said: أنا رحت، أمم، على مطعم مع صحابي والـ مطعم صوت عالي كتير
rows.why: Medi said 'el-ma63am sawt 3aali' omitting the possessive pronoun suffix -o on sawt pointing back to the restaurant (A4 possessive endings).
rows.english: and the restaurant's volume was very loud

rows.chat: ana mit7ammes la-bukra 3ashaan bukra m5a66et ishi
rows.why: Medi dropped English 'for' into an Arabic sentence; sheet has 'for / to | la | لَ | la' and 'excited | mit7ammes | متحمس لَ'.

rows.medi_said: Uh, no، هد-- هذا، هذا هذا يوم الخميس.
rows.why: Medi said 'hada yoam el-5amees' to mean this coming Thursday; Amal corrected that coming Thursday is 'el-5amees el-jaay' (sheet: 'next / the coming (m) | El-jaay | الجاي').

rows.chat: el-yoam balbes bluze noss kum soda u bantaloan azra2 u kundara soda
rows.why: ban6aloan is masculine so its color adjective must be aswad, not feminine soda (A8 gender on adjectives).

rows.medi_said: Uh, كان نفس المرة، نفس المرة.
rows.amal_said: ka، kanat why؟ ... Because mara is.
rows.why: marra is feminine, so kaan must be feminine kaanat (B6 / B18).
Medi invented a non-word 'tlayt' for 'I met'; Amal gave him elta2ait (sheet: 'i met up | Ana lta2ayt | أنا التقيت').

rows.amal_said: What does alta'at take؟ There is two options.
rows.chat: awal marra ana jarrabet akel 3arabi kaanat nafs el-marra illi ana elta2ait ma3 emm 5atibti la-awal marra.
rows.why: elta2a takes the preposition ma3 when meeting with someone (D2 verb + fixed preposition).
Medi slipped again using masculine kaan instead of feminine kaanat before nafs el-marra (B6).

rows.medi_said: أكثر من- تنت- آآآ تنتين سنين
rows.amal_said: Mm-mm-mm. How do you say two years؟ ... So how do I say dual for year؟
rows.why: Dual has its own form; two years is santain, not tintain sineen (E1 number + noun / E3 time units).

rows.amal_said: I tried. You have to point back to it.
rows.chat: awal akel ana jarrabto kaan 7umus u zaitoon
rows.why: Fronted object requires a resumptive pronoun on the verb pointing back to it: jarrabto (C2 pointer rule).

rows.medi_said: And then، uh، تاني أكل أنا جربت،
rows.chat: taani akel ana jarrabto msa55an. u kaan fi aa5er el-3asha 7ilu falastini
rows.why: Medi omitted the resumptive pronoun -o again after fronting the object (C2 pointer rule).

rows.medi_said: Uh، كليًا الـ مفضل uh، أكل-- no. أكل
rows.amal_said: كليًا is like completely. ... You would say بشكل عام.
rows.why: Medi used kulliyyan (completely) to mean 'in general'; Amal corrected to bishakel 3aam (sheet: 'in general / generally | Bishakel 3aam | بشكل عام').

rows.medi_said: fuck، I don't remember if مفضل goes before or after. أكل المفضل، مفضل الأكل. No، أكل المفضل.
rows.why: In a definite noun-adjective phrase, el- must go on both the noun and the adjective: el-akel el-mufaddal (A7 / A23).
kul alone means every, whereas kul + el- means all (A11 kul: all vs every).
Medi missed el- on akel in the definite noun phrase el-akel el-mufaddal (A7 / A23).

rows.medi_said: No, so هادي كمان الـ كمان أكلة
rows.amal_said: كمان at the end. Don't worry about كمان.
rows.why: kamaan before a noun means another/one more; to mean also/as well, it goes elsewhere or at the end of the sentence (A19).
rows.english: this is also my fiancée's favorite dish

rows.why: akle is feminine, so the adjective must match with feminine ending -e: el-mufaddale (A8 / A23).
awaa3i is plural, so Amal recasts the adjective to masculine plural mufaddaleen (A8 / A9).

rows.amal_said: الطريق التاني. No, you said طريق التاني.
rows.why: Medi dropped el- on the noun in the definite noun phrase el-6aree2 el-taani (A7 noun + adjective / A14).

rows.amal_said: Mm, this is scared. What's scary?
rows.why: Medi used 5aayef (feeling scared) instead of bey5awwef (scary); Amal prompted him until he gave bey5awwef (sheet: 'scary | bey5awwef | بيخوف').

rows.medi_said: بشرب... Oh, I don't know how to say drink. شرب.
rows.why: Medi asked how to say drink / juice; Amal supplied 3a9ir (sheet: 'juice | 3a9ir | عصير').

rows.medi_said: So الـ Halloween بيبسوت لـ... ولد
rows.amal_said: It just makes them happy, so you don't need any preposition. ... So no preposition needed.
rows.why: byebse6 takes a direct object without preposition la-; Amal explicitly instructed that no preposition is needed (D2 verb + preposition).

rows.medi_said: El walad or walad. No. Yeah, el walad. El walad el zahar.
rows.why: Medi said singular el-walad instead of plural el-awlaad / el-wlaad for 'kids' (A9 plurals).
